_description: Task 1 challenge baseline: one doublet, one time step. Same topology as simulator_examples/projects/doublet_plant.json (Separator -> FilterA -> HeatExchanger -> FilterB, Boiler/CHP on the secondary side), with the official challenge inputs and tagged assumptions. Units follow doublet_plant.json: SI flow [m3/s] except the wells [m3/h], pressure [bar], temperature [C], caloric_value [J/kg]. Run with hackathon_work/run_doublet_challenge.py, which also overrides the well models' brine properties (see _brine_pvt_override).

_brine_pvt_override._description: Applied at runtime to every well DPDT by run_doublet_challenge.py (gemini_model's PVTConstantSTP defaults are 1000 kg/m3, 1 mPa s, 4217 J/kg/K).

_design_controls._description: Limits used by doublet_model.solve_producer_controls when solving esp_freq_hz / wellhead_pressure for a target brine flow.

_provenance._brine_pvt_override.CPL, heat_exchanger/: ASSUMED 4100 J/(kg K), technical guide illustrative value.
_provenance.heat_exchanger/boiler/chp.fluid_density: OFFICIAL 1030 kg/m3 brine; ASSUMED the same props on the district-water side (the models use one set for both sides).
_provenance.producer_well.reservoir_pressure_bar, in: OFFICIAL 250 bar(g); injector in the same reservoir.
_provenance.*.productivity_index_m3h_per_bar: DERIVED 12.1 = 2*pi*k*h/(mu*ln(re/rw)) with k=200 mD, h=100 m, mu=0.4 mPa s; ASSUMED re/rw=1e4, skin=0, injectivity = productivity.
_provenance.*.trajectory_table: ASSUMED vertical wells to the OFFICIAL 2500 m TVD midpoint, ID 0.15 m (example ID).
_provenance.producer_well.ambient_temperature_c: DERIVED 49.5 C = mean formation temperature (12 + 87)/2; only used for the in-well temperature profile of the nodal solve, does not affect flow (constant PVT).
_provenance.producer_well.esp_depth_m / esp: ASSUMED: GEMINI example (HC27000 curve, 10 stages, 650 m). Reported pump power is recomputed as Q*dp/0.70 by the run script.
_provenance.producer_well.esp_freq_hz: CONTROL: solved per run for the target brine flow; 65 Hz is only the stored starting value.
_provenance._design_controls.esp_freq_hz_range: ASSUMED 30-70 Hz variable-speed-drive range (example runs at 65 Hz).
_provenance._design_controls.min_surface_pressure_ba: ASSUMED 1.0 bar minimum anywhere in the surface chain (filter_b outlet = injector pump suction); sets the wellhead pressure floor.
_provenance._design_controls.max_wellhead_pressure_b: ASSUMED 30 bar upper bound when the wellhead must be choked to reduce flow.
_provenance.separator/filter_a/filter_b.temperature_: ASSUMED 0.2 K each, short insulated surface equipment.
_provenance.boiler/chp.caloric_value: DERIVED 29.67 MJ/kg = 0.8 * 35.8 MJ/Nm3 (CH4 LHV, standard value) / 0.9653 kg/Nm3.
_provenance.boiler/chp.gas_emission_factor: DERIVED 68.6 kg CO2/GJ = 1.0 Nm3 CO2/Nm3 gas (0.8 combustion + 0.2 pass-through) * 1.9635 kg/Nm3 / 28.64 MJ/Nm3.
_provenance.heat_exchanger.heat_transfer_coefficient: DESIGN parameter (UA, W/K); 250 kW/K is the GEMINI example value and one option.
_provenance.boundary producer_well.wellhead_pressure: CONTROL: 3.0 bar nominal (GEMINI example); raised to the surface-pressure floor or adjusted when the ESP frequency range cannot reach the target flow.
_provenance.boundary producer_well.wellhead_temperat: DERIVED 85 C nominal (~0.44 MW wellbore loss, U = 10 W/m2K); the run script recomputes it from the solved flow rate.
_provenance.boundary secondary_splitter.input: DERIVED per run: heating demand per doublet / (rho * cp * (100 - 60 C)); 140 m3/h is only the stored starting value.
_provenance.boundary heat_exchanger.secondary_temper: ASSUMED 60 C district heating return (sensitivity 50 / 70 C).

absorber_generator._description: Absorption chiller generator: zero resistance; temperature_drop = drive heat / (m_dot * cp), set per day.
